newsitem.title: USA: Ascent Entertainment lauds spin off.
newsitem.headline: Ascent Entertainment lauds spin off.

text.p: Ascent Entertainment Group Inc on Friday applauded a decision by Comsat Corp to spin off its 80.67 percent ownership interest in Ascent to shareholders.

"We strongly support this action and will now work diligently to see that it is executed properly. We agree with COMSAT that, operating as separate companies, Ascent and COMSAT will be better able to carry out their individual business strategies. It's time for Ascent to move forward as a public media and entertainment company," Ascent said in a statement issued Friday evening.
Comsat announced the spin-off earlier Friday, saying its board approved the decision after the Internal Revenue Service ruled it would not be taxable to the corporation or its shareholders.
